No, that isn't what the output shows. The loss analysis didn't run. The zonal stats tool returned an error saying the source coverage this asset needs hadn't been prepared, and that no observation was made. So there is no result at all, neither "loss" nor "no loss."

The run metadata only lists the settings and datasets that were meant to be used: Hansen/UMD Global Forest Change (GFC-2025-v1.13), JRC GFC2020, a 2020-12-31 baseline, and a 30% tree cover threshold. The asset area is also blank (null), which fits with the asset's data not having been prepared.

To get an answer, the coverage for ASSET-J needs to be prepared and the analysis rerun. Until then, the asset's loss status is unknown, and the output can't be used to say it is clear.
